title: Production worker assignment policy fixes

excluded_rows.reason: Downstream dependency only; no signoff closeout or pass promotion in Batch 24F.

PROD-002.scenario: Day-only factory with no night worker.
PROD-002.expected: Must match the pilot's operating decision; if valid production is blocked, pilot is No-Go unless night assignment is genuinely mandatory.
PROD-002.actual: Day-only factory operation is not currently supported by the production logging boundary. getShiftSetupData only exposes eligible looms when both day and night standing assignments exist, and bulkLogProduction rejects positive production unless both day and night workers are assigned. If the pilot decision allows day-only factories, this is a No-Go condition for those factories.

PROD-004.expected: Supervisor can intentionally select/log the actual worker or receives a workable owner-remapping flow.
PROD-004.actual: A one-off substitute worker cannot be intentionally logged on the production screen unless that worker matches the standing assignment for the machine and shift. The server guard compares expectedShiftWorkerId to log.worker_id and rejects mismatches with LOOM_SETUP_INCOMPLETE, so the only workaround is remapping the assignment rather than logging the actual substitute on that shift.

SIGNOFF-01.scenario: All active looms accounted for with production or downtime reason.
SIGNOFF-01.actual: Current-run evidence is still not sufficient to sign off that all active looms are accounted for with production or downtime. Batch 2 closed the production/stock correction portion, but day-only setup and substitute-worker production logging issues remain open.
SIGNOFF-01.batch_24f_decision: Inspected for dependency impact only; not closed or promoted.

PROD-002: Added a selected-shift worker assignment policy helper.
getShiftSetupData now exposes active looms with active production targets without requiring both day and night standing workers.
Supervisor production save now validates the worker assigned to the selected shift only.
Day-shift production with a day worker and no night worker is allowed at source level.
Night-shift production without a night worker returns SHIFT_WORKER_REQUIRED with an actionable night-worker assignment message.
Loom activation and Factory Today setup now require at least one day or night assignment instead of both shifts, avoiding false day-only setup blockage.
PROD-004: No substitute-worker persistence was invented because production_logs has only one worker_id in the current logging path.
If a submitted worker differs from the selected standing shift worker, the server returns SUBSTITUTE_REASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED.
The mismatch message directs the user to reassign the shift worker before logging a substitute so payroll and loom accountability are not silently wrong.
Production remains attributable only to the selected standing shift worker.
SIGNOFF-01: Dependency improved because day-only and substitute-worker source behavior is now explicit.
SIGNOFF-01 remains fail/open pending current-run owner sign-off runtime proof.
